content:
Tara (AE): Partner briefing  Redwood reseller program question. Partner 'StratusResell' asks for a tiered margin: 6% on first $100k ARR, 10% on incremental ARR above $100k, and an introductory 22% customer discount for first 6 months. They also want permission to onboard sub-resellers and take a 3rd-party margin. Need deal-desk + finance + legal guidance.

Hassan (Partner Lead): StratusResell is focused in APAC SMB channels. Their ask for sub-reseller flow is strategic but we need guardrails: MDF reporting, SKU restrictions, and no white-labeling. They claim this structure will accelerate 400k pipeline.

June (Deal Desk): TL;DR: tiered margin request + temporary deep customer discount + sub-reseller approval. Questions for Finance: how does tiered margin impact NRR and deal segmentation? For Legal: policy on sub-reseller margins & attribution. Also need to decide whether margin is calculated on gross invoice or net after discounts.

Arun (Finance): Quick calc options:
- Option A (gross): margin paid on gross list before discount
- Option B (net): margin paid on net after customer discount and co-sell credits
We generally prefer net-based to avoid overpaying on deep discounting. Example model with net-based:
```
commit = 150000
intro_discount = 0.22
year1_revenue_net = commit * (1 - intro_discount)
tier1_margin_payable = min(commit,100000) * 0.06
tier2_margin_payable = max(0, commit - 100000) * 0.10
```
Run shows higher payout if gross-based. Need to set MDF and clawback schedule.

Tara (AE): Partner insists margin must be calculated gross because their GTM ops rely on predictable cashflows. They're okay with a 6-week onboarding holdback until first invoice clears.

contracts-bot: Flag: sub-reseller approval requires addendum. MDF and margin stacking need explicit anti-circumvention clause. Also note reseller accreditation and audit rights.

Hassan (Partner Lead): Proposed compromise:
- Approve tiered margin but pay on net after discounts
- Cap total margin payable at 12% of ARR to limit exposure
- Introductory customer discount window: 22% for first 90 days (not 6 months)
- Sub-resellers permitted with written list and quarterly audit
- MDF: $10k one-time with 60-day reporting and clawback if not used on joint activities
If partner refuses, fallback: flat 9% margin and 18% intro discount for 3 months.

June (Deal Desk): I'll route this compromise to Finance + Legal. Also need RevRec to weigh in on 2-year revenue recognition if we allow longer intro discounts. Please upload partner pipeline evidence.

Arun (Finance): Net-based margin + cap at 12% looks workable. Need to see sensitivity vs. expected token/embedding consumption per customer to model unit economics. Also request payment schedule: monthly true-up with quarterly reconciliation and clawback window of 12 months.

Tara (AE): Partner will accept 90-day intro period and net-based margin if we allow sub-resellers under audit. They prefer monthly margin payments.

contracts-bot: Routing to Legal and RevRec. Required approvals: Finance, Legal, RevRec, CRO. Estimated review time 48h.

Hassan (Partner Lead): I'll notify StratusResell that we're moving forward with the proposed compromise pending formal approvals.

Tara (AE): Need to close by next Wednesday to hit partner Q. Thanks everyone. :pray:
